name: jyu_lump
desc: Make the puddle heave up into a thick, heavy, shapeless mound of the same glossy brown paint with cream swirls rising from the middle of the puddle, like a huge heavy body hunched and buried deep inside the goo, about to get up: low and very wide, about half of a person's height, as wide as a very fat man, sagging and squashed under its own weight. The surface is only smooth lumpy goo with big swelling bubbles, thick sagging layers, heavy drips and sticky strands running down into the puddle. Absolutely no muscles, no arms, no legs, no feet, no hands, no head, no face, no body lines or anatomy visible. Same colors, outline and pixel art style.
